classifications.rationale: The President presently assigns specified presidential functions to the Secretary of State, with consultation requirements; any sanctions or other legal consequences arise only through later exercise of the delegated authority.
classifications.evidence: I hereby delegate to the Secretary of State the functions and authorities vested in the President

classifications.rationale: The President assigns statutory presidential functions to the Secretary of State without directing any specified sanctions determination or other legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: I hereby delegate to the Secretary of State the functions and authorities vested in the President

classifications.rationale: The President delegates sanction-selection and implementation authority among executive officials; sanctions occur only if later selected under that delegated authority.
classifications.evidence: authority to implement such sanctions is delegated to the relevant agency heads

classifications.rationale: The President delegates conditional sanction authority to the Treasury Secretary and implementation authority to relevant agency heads; the segment does not itself select or impose sanctions.
classifications.evidence: I hereby delegate to the Secretary of the Treasury the functions and authorities vested in the President

classifications.rationale: The President conditionally delegates implementation functions to the Treasury Secretary after sanctions have been selected elsewhere, constituting an internal assignment of authority.
classifications.evidence: I hereby delegate to the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State, the functions vested in the President

classifications.rationale: The President allocates CISADA determination, waiver, reporting, sanction, and implementation functions among executive officials and preserves prior delegations; legal consequences depend on later exercises of those delegated functions.
classifications.evidence: I hereby delegate functions and authorities vested in the President by CISADA

classifications.rationale: The President assigns statutory presidential functions to the State and Treasury Secretaries according to their areas of responsibility.
classifications.evidence: I hereby delegate the functions vested in the President

classifications.rationale: This introductory clause assigns presidential functions and authorities under the cited statutes, with the specific allocations supplied by the following text.
classifications.evidence: I hereby delegate the functions and authorities vested in the President by ITRSHRA

classifications.rationale: Most of the segment allocates presidential functions among executive officials, but it inseparably also mandates all federal agencies to implement sanctions that the Secretary of State later determines should be imposed, a dictated later legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: all agencies of the United States Government are hereby directed to take all appropriate measures within their authority to carry out any sanctions
